title: Raas Garba Festival 2026 Fri, Oct 16th - 7:30 Pm
description: Experience the Vibrancy of BAYVP-ICA-CCF Raas Garba Festival 2026
long_description:
Experience the Vibrancy of BAYVP-ICA-CCF Raas Garba Festival 2026
Get ready for a night of jubilation and culturally rich amusement at the BAYVP-ICA-CCF Raas Garba Festival happening on Friday, the 16th of October, 2026. Brace yourself for a night filled with enchanting Gujarati music and breathtaking Navratri/Dandiya dance performances. This event, organized by Bay Area Youth Vaishnav Parivar, promises to be a vibrant celebration of traditions, bringing together the local community in a spectacular way.
A Stage that Awaits Its Stars
Though the artist for the evening remains a surprise, rest assured that the performers will be of the highest caliber, bringing their unique styles and backgrounds to the stage. Their performances will not only entertain but also introduce you to the rich tapestry of Gujarati culture and Navratri/Dandiya dance traditions. Stay tuned for the big reveal!
Step into the Charm of Shreemaya Krishnadham Haveli
The event will take place at the Shreemaya Krishnadham Haveli, located at 175 Nortech Parkway in the lively city of San Jose, CA, United States. The venue is renowned for its safety and easy accessibility. Enjoy the nearby attractions of this vibrant city before or after the event. Parking won't be an issue with ample spaces available. For a complete cultural experience, we recommend visiting one of the many nearby Indian restaurants.
Secure Your Entry - Ticket Information
Ensure your participation in this grand celebration by securing your tickets. Adults can enjoy the night for $25.00, while children aged 5 to 12 years can participate for $20.00. We also offer a special price of $20.00 for our valued seniors aged 70 years and above. Come, be a part of this vibrant festival and create memories of a lifetime.
